# OutOfNetworkNY

> OutOfNetworkNY (outofnetworkny.com) is the out-of-network provider reimbursement practice of Madison Law Firm PLLC, 579 Fifth Avenue, 2nd Floor, New York, NY 10017, (212) 300-3191. It represents New York physicians, groups, and surgery centers in New York IDR (Financial Services Law Article 6) and federal No Surprises Act IDR. Content current as of November 5, 2026. Attorney Advertising.
